title: 'susi connect' wires MCP and HTTP clients to the host
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Print or, with consent, write the bearer token and endpoint into detected clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenAI-compatible tools). Tests zc_client_connect_*.
